claim: Static architecture change: Team Goal progress snapshots are coalesced per step and each consumed batch merges through one Team state load/write; no runtime performance or type-check claim.

change.pending_policy: latest snapshot per step_id replaces older unconsumed snapshots
change.counter_merge: monotonic max of same-epoch observed steps_taken and total_retries
change.scope_limit: pending map scales with unique steps observed in current phase; total task-graph memory is not capped here
change.persistence_batch: one Team lock and one state load per notification batch; one state write only if records or counters changed
change.record_change_detection: includes status, attempts, attempt_id, phase_epoch, output, error, skip_reason and validation_receipts

limits: Coalescing can omit intermediate states for one step; the latest snapshot and final phase merge preserve current state.
Pending snapshot count remains proportional to unique step IDs observed during the phase.
No speed, memory, storage-write or delivery-quality gain is claimed without runtime evidence.
